an10.188:1.1: CLXXXVIII. Dukkhavipākañ ca vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi sukhavipākañ ca, taṃ suṇātha . . . pe . . . Katamo ca bhikkhave dukkhavipāko dhammo? Pāṇātipāto . . . pe . . . micchādiṭṭhi. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhavipāko dhammo.
an10.188:2.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave sukhavipāko dhammo? Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī . . . pe . . . sammādiṭṭhi. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sukhavipāko dhammo ti. Sādhuvaggo aṭṭhamo.
